Card Q&A.a: The player that activated this card's effect chooses.
Card Q&A.q: When this card's [When Digivolving] effect is used to place more than one of the opponent's level 3 Digimon on top of their security stack, which player decides the order the cards are placed in?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Place all level 3 Digimon face down on top of their owners' security stacks in any order. Then, all of your opponent’s level 4 or higher Digimon get -3000 DP and gain ＜Security Attack -1＞ until the end of their turn.
[When Attacking] By trashing 1 card with [Numemon] in its name in this Digimon's digivolution cards, place 1 of your opponent’s Digimon face down at the bottom of their security stack.
Special Digivolution Condition: [Digivolve] 4 from Lv.5 w/[Monzaemon] or [Numemon] in name
